title: 冰岭契约

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮目视：左侧持杖皇帝、前景罗盘与四石体、右后斜向冰桥可辨，台基厚实延伸到底；仅执行者选定母版，未做用户审美复核。

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE original opaque full-frame 1024x1536 vertical Emperor tarot master, theme 冰岭契约 / Ice Ridge Covenant. Use supplied image as identity reference: exactly one mature bearded dark-haired crowned emperor wearing deep blue-purple robes, seated on a substantial ice-rock throne and holding one scepter. One compass and exactly FOUR separate simple stone solids on foreground ledge: cube, pyramid, sphere, truncated pyramid; individually legible and stably supported. New composition: throne LEFT OF CENTER, a massive ice bridge starts at the same solid rock terrace and angles into the RIGHT BACKGROUND across snow-covered ridges to distant peaks. Side light emphasizes the structure. Steel blue, silver white, muted dark gold, natural skin. Throne base, icy terrace, bridgehead and front stone ledge are continuous, thick, contact-grounded, extending into bottom bleed. Refined painterly fantasy tarot with thin gold celestial border and atmospheric cold distance. No extra people, no duplicate compass or stones, no letters, title, numbers, watermark, logo. One full opaque image.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass visual check; no transparent layers or assembly.

generationRuns.prompt: Edit the supplied image. Output exactly one 1024x1536 image. Keep the original canvas coordinates and size of RETAINED objects only. Objects explicitly removed must be deleted completely; do not preserve their number. No redesign, no recentering, no frame except when frame is specifically requested. BACKGROUND PLATE ONLY. Delete ALL people, ALL animals, ALL main foreground props, ALL foreground support platforms/floors and their contact shadows, ALL floating foreground decoration, and the entire outer border/corner ornaments. NO people or animals may remain, including silhouettes and reflections. Reconstruct the distant environment naturally behind deleted objects. Keep only the distant landscape/architecture and original atmosphere. Do not add a second copy of the support ground. Opaque RGB image. Specific removed connected group: 人物、杖、王座、罗盘与四石体为稳定组；本主题支撑归属：石座与冰岩地台完整，桥头不切成薄片. Environment ownership details: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。. Highest priority: an EMPTY clean environment, absolutely no protagonists or foreground props. Remove ALL decorative symbols attached to the margins, including the upper and lower crescents, attached stars, corner ornaments and rectangular border strokes. Fill those pixels with continuous natural environment textures. The result is a full-bleed clean background with absolutely NO card furniture. Image 1 is the edit target; opaque background plate.
generationRuns.conclusion: Generated candidate; user requested collective visual acceptance later.
